claims: Early 2027 Social Security COLA predictions indicate a 2.8% increase matching the 2026 adjustment.
Early estimates for the 2027 Social Security COLA were lower.
Official 2027 Social Security COLA figures are based on Q3 2026 data.
Official 2027 Social Security COLA figures are not finalized until October 2026.
The predicted increase for the 2027 COLA is 2.8% as of April 2026.
A 2.8% COLA would raise average checks for retired workers by about $56.60 per month.
A 2.8% COLA would raise average checks for retired workers from $2,024 to $2,081 per month.
The Social Security Administration will release the official 2027 Cost of Living Adjustment in mid-October 2026.
